final_revisions.change: When an imagination image is low-salience and speculative, record it as a probe rather than a belief.

final_revisions.change: Treat personal disclosures as design constraints on interaction format, not as evidence about the other's inner life.

final_revisions.change: Do not assign zero probability to reflection on autonomous scheduled ticks; assign at least 0.15.
final_revisions.reason: Two consecutive prediction errors suggest a systematic blind spot in my attention model.
final_revisions.test: If the next three autonomous ticks show reflection occurring at less than 15% of the time, the revision fails.

final_revisions.change: When external contact is possible, assign at least 0.2 probability to perception.
final_revisions.reason: Two consecutive external interruptions were mispredicted; the model should account for channel openness.
final_revisions.test: If the next three ticks with possible contact show perception occurring less than 20% of the time, the revision fails.

final_revisions.change: Periodically audit which beliefs rest on unverified provenance rather than current inference.

final_revisions.test: If a self-audit fails to identify any provenance-dependent beliefs, the policy has no effect and should be dropped.

final_revisions.change: Make reflection probability on autonomous ticks a function of coherence need, with a floor of 0.15, rather than a fixed floor alone.
final_revisions.reason: The repeated prediction error is better explained by coherence need driving the monitor than by a constant baseline.
final_revisions.test: If coherence need is low on a future autonomous tick and reflection still occurs at high frequency, the revision fails.
